identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit 'Be A Mentor Inc' located in Hayward, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 94-3165640), matching the agenda's 'Be a Mentor, Inc.' and 'Hayward, CA'

Organization's own website (beamentor.org) is a Hayward, CA nonprofit and describes a Volunteer Management System used to coordinate mentoring programs across agencies, consistent with a Technology Services Department services agreement
research.notes: The agenda describes the contract as Technology Services; no page found explicitly links the organization to OUSD, and the tie rests on name and city match plus the organization's Volunteer Management System. The older beamentor.org/Contact.htm page lists a different phone and a 1260 B Street address; the current homepage was used instead. The homepage also lists a Los Angeles office.

profile.summary: A nonprofit organization founded in 1992 that connects youth with volunteer adult mentors. It runs mentoring programs for at-risk youth, including foster children, with in-person and virtual options. It also provides a Volunteer Management System used to coordinate mentoring programs across agencies.

sources.title: Be A Mentor Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Name and Hayward location match the agenda; ProPublica confirms the 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-3165640) and beamentor.org confirms the 1992 founding, mentoring programs, Volunteer Management System, and the listed phone, generic email and Hayward address. A search also shows OUSD uses an online volunteer registration system hosted by Be A Mentor, Inc., which fits a Technology Services agreement.
